title: Feelings 3
note: Nuanced emotion adjectives above leaf_feelings_a2. FOLDS IN codex/parked-stressed-stressful.json: the person-feels vs thing-causes job with a cause form that is not -ing. First draft 2026-09-02. · 2026-09-04 B1 loop: only 10 of the draft's 36 tiles were new — 26 were words already taught (the whole A2 -ed/-ing set, plus six leaf_self_b1 owns). F7/F8: the recycled ones are now two **You already know** review boards, and the Match list is 36 words that are new at this slot: stronger -ed feelings, the feeling NOUNS English needs at B1 (relief, joy, pride, shame, regret, envy, sympathy, panic), and the cause forms. · The parked spec's four pairs are all here — stressed/stressful, scared/scary, pleased/pleasant, delighted/delightful — with the -ed halves on the review board and a **person and the cause** table page carrying the contrast. · sentences 8 → 36, one gappable frame per lemma. E10: Use is use_mode rewrite, 12 items. · Frames page was noun frames (I have a … / I need a …) on a pack of adjectives; fixed. · Pool-checked against everything taught before leaf_feelings_b1 — 0 unknown types. · 2026-09-04: seven rewrite items re-cut — the -ing adjectives all needed the `is` standing in the prompt.

intro.title: You already know · how you feel
You already know · what causes it
intro.title_cz: Už znáš · co ten pocit způsobuje

intro.title: You will use these words in
frames: I am fed up with … · *Mám dost …*
It was a … when … · *Byla to …, když …*
intro.note: The person feels **stressed**; the thing is **stressful**. Same job as *bored / boring*, but the ending changes — there is no *stressing*. Same for **scared / scary** and **delighted / delightful**.
intro.note_cz: Člověk je **stressed**, věc je **stressful**. Tvar *stressing* neexistuje.
